issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync inside getSourceMap runs per stack frame with no caching.
issues.detail: getSourceMap fires per frame during error formatting and does readFileSync (plus a second read inside convert-source-map) every time, with no memoization. Deep stacks hitting the same file produce O(frames * fileSize) work where O(uniqueFiles * fileSize) suffices. Add a Map<file, SourceMap|undefined> cache keyed by file path.

issues.description: resolvedSources change to resolve(from, '..', s) lacks an invariant comment and direct unit test.
issues.detail: The one-line change in DecodedMap silently shifts semantics: 'from' is now treated as a file whose parent contains sources, matching the sourcemap spec. The intent is obscured by the '..' trick; path.resolve(path.dirname(from), s) would name the intent. Add a direct unit test on resolvedSources so this doesn't get reverted.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' for missing map files, silently masking errors.
issues.detail: Returning the literal string '{}' as a fake empty source map hides real problems (broken sourceMappingURL, missing .map file) behind a silent no-op. Downstream code can't distinguish 'no map' from 'map pointed at nothing'. Return undefined and let the caller decide, or log once at debug level.

issues.description: Mixing 'pathe' and 'node:path' in the same file invites Windows path-separator bugs.
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from 'pathe' but new code imports node:path and uses path.resolve/path.dirname. pathe normalizes separators across platforms; node:path does not. Pick one — the codebase's voice is pathe — unless there's a concrete reason to deviate.

issues.description: readFileSync on a hot error path has no try/catch and can itself throw.
issues.detail: existsSync + readFileSync is racy and readFileSync can still throw (EACCES, EISDIR, symlink loop). If it throws inside parseErrorStacktrace's getSourceMap callback, the original error reporting dies and the user sees a sourcemap error instead of their test failure. Wrap in try/catch and fall through to no source map.

issues.description: New convert-source-map dependency and helper placement deserve a second look.
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile is a stateless (code, filePath) -> SourceMap transform that belongs next to DecodedMap in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts, not in test-run.ts. The repo already ships @jridgewell/trace-mapping; pulling in convert-source-map for ~30 lines of regex+fs work warrants measuring the win before taking the dep.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the fix is real, targeted, and substantively correct: the resolvedSources change matches the sourcemap spec and the new external-module path works. But the implementation is under-audited and written like it shipped under deadline. The load-bearing concerns are synchronous readFileSync per stack frame with no cache, the '{}' fallback that lies to convert-source-map about missing maps, and the absent invariant/unit test for the DecodedMap change. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — cache reads, stop returning '{}', add a direct unit test on resolvedSources, and clean up the pathe/node:path mixing before landing.
